subject: Hosted API baseline rates & sample volume scenarios
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara@brightcart.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted API baseline rates + example volume curves

Priyom / Ben,

Thanks for taking a look. Attached is BrightCart's short RFQ (BrightCart-RFQ-0706.pdf) — we're evaluating hosted API economics for a multi-region recommendation feature. A few asks to help us model: 

- Baseline per-token rates for the hosted API at current published specs.
- Examples of how effective per-token cost falls with sustained 3M / 10M / 30M token/month patterns.
- Any minimum commit or term that unlocks deeper discounts, and how overage is handled (monthly true-up vs credit burn).

We have an internal procurement deadline the week of Aug 10; a short worksheet (pricing-scenarios.xlsx) with sample consumption estimates is attached. Can you send a short note with representative scenarios and the baseline ratecard? 

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min call if that helps.

Sara Lopez
Head of Platform & Procurement, BrightCart
Sara.lopez@brightcart.com
(415) 555-0199

-- attachment: BrightCart-RFQ-0706.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline rates + example volume curves

Sara — thanks, and appreciated the worksheet. High-level answers here; attaching a short ratecard + three example tier scenarios (redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf).

1) Baseline hosted rates (public):
   - Gen tokens (prompt+completion combined): $0.00045 / token
   - Embeddings (per vector): $0.0006 / vector

2) Example effective per-token after sustained usage (illustrative):
   - 3M tokens/mo sustained -> effective $0.00038/token (5–12% discount via 3-month prepay or monthly commit)
   - 10M tokens/mo sustained -> effective $0.00030/token (15–25% via 6–12 month commit with tiering)
   - 30M tokens/mo sustained -> effective $0.00019/token (30–45% with multi-region reserved capacity + quantization/optimizations)

Notes on structure and overage:
- We offer flat monthly committed tiers (prepaid or billed monthly) and a rolling true-up for overage. Overage can be billed at the next tier price or drawn from a credit bucket depending on contract.
- Deepest discounts require both a term (6–12 months) and a minimum commit for Dedicated or Reserved capacity; hosted-only discounts are available but capped relative to Dedicated.
- We can run a quick sensitivity analysis against the numbers in your spreadsheet to produce a 1-page scenario you can take to procurement.

Next steps: I can run the numbers against the attached pricing-scenarios.xlsx and return a short table with "expected unit cost" and "monthly bill" across your three traffic shapes. Would you like that, or prefer a short call with Ben to walk through assumptions?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (512) 555-0123

-- attachment: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Priyom — nice summary. A couple of commercial tweaks to propose before we finalize: 

- Floor discount for hosted deals: cannot go below 20% off published rate without exec sign-off (because of backing infra cost).
- Offer a 90-day performance credit if latency SLOs for your primary region miss targets more than twice in a month.

Looping in Marissa for legal/ops language and final approval on credit terms. Priyom — please include the "monthly true-up" example in the sensitivity table (line item for overage priced at next-tier rate).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0170

Sara
